description: Ca₂NaSiO₄F crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.56 Å. There is one shorter (2.19 Å) and one longer (2.83 Å) Na-F bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-3.07 Å. There is one shorter (2.44 Å) and one longer (2.85 Å) Na-F bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.89 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O and one F atom to form distorted NaO₄F square pyramids that share corners with two SiO₃F tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one SiO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one CaO₅F octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.35 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.22 Å. There are eight inequivalent Ca sites. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.65 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.17 Å. In the fourth Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.89 Å. There is one shorter (2.37 Å) and one longer (2.38 Å) Ca-F bond length. In the fifth Ca site, Ca is bonded to five O and one F atom to form distorted CaO₅F octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent SiO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄F square pyramid. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.68 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.31 Å. In the sixth Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.40 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.53 Å. In the seventh Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.53 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.21 Å. In the eighth Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.80 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.35 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to three O and one F atom to form SiO₃F tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F square pyramid and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.63 Å. The Si-F bond length is 1.68 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SiO₅ trigonal bipyramid and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄F square pyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.67 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₅F octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F square pyramid, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₃F tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-72°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.72 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to five O atoms to form SiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent CaO₅F octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄F square pyramid, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-43°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.85 Å. There are sixteen inequivalent O sites.
